description: This file contains utility functions and templates for string manipulation, case-insensitive comparisons, whitespace trimming, base64 encoding, and system mode file management within the Utils::String namespace.

classes.name: loc_equal
classes.description: A template struct for locale-aware character comparison, used for case-insensitive string operations.

methods.name: find_substr_ci
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive search for a substring within a string, returning the position or -1 if not found.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a string contains a given substring in a case-insensitive manner.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive comparison of two strings for equality.

methods.name: ltrim
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: rtrim
methods.description: Removes trailing whitespace characters from a string.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes whitespace from both ends of a string.

methods.name: stringContains
methods.description: Performs a case-insensitive check if one string contains another.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiter characters.

methods.name: imageEncoder
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string, with optional padding.

methods.name: removeExtraWhitespaces
methods.description: Removes extra spaces from an input string, producing a cleaned output string.

methods.name: updateSystemModeFile
methods.description: Updates or adds entries in the system mode configuration file based on specified actions.

methods.name: getSystemModePropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific property for a given system mode from the configuration file.

methods.name: replaceString
methods.description: Replaces all occurrences of a substring within a string with another substring.
